text.tspan: Annual number of people injured by all natural disasters excluding
Disasters include events such as earthquakes, volcanoes, droughts, wildfires, storms, and floods. Extreme temperatures are
not included here because their geographical and time coverage is poor, making consistent comparisons difficult.

tspan.tspan: Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting
